authority: Antonio, 14 November 2026: «Può aver senso aggiungere laureati in ingegneria biomedica ammessi allo studio?»; «Vai con la 1 intanto […] e nel frattempo cerca di sistemare anche il database facendo tutte le prove del caso senza rompere nulla»; «Aggiungi sul sito qualcosa che ti spinga a mettere una nota in circostanze particolari»; «No scusa, metti Ingegneria Biomedica nell'elenco come gli altri. La precisazione su "laureato" mettila che valga per tutti. Sistema anche l'informativa privacy.»

eligibility.added: Biomedical Engineering listed like the other programmes (key bme, label 'Ingegneria biomedica'); adults of the University of Pisa enrolled in or graduated from any listed programme
eligibility.mechanism: amendable programme in site code (engine.AMENDABLE_PROGRAMMES), activated with the audited `flask add-programme bme` (14:30:01); the earlier activation bme_graduate (14:23:47) is ignored and was never used; the signed configuration snapshot is unchanged
eligibility.eligible_rule: identity declared after activation, eligibility declared, no review flag: basis adult_unipi_approved_programme; graduates write 'laureata/laureato' or 'graduate' as the year of study
eligibility.export: student_export_metadata demographics.programme gains the optional bucket biomedical_engineering

export_after_rebase: export-v2 leaves out reads of pairs retired by the v2.1 rebase (they carry the previous package hash; pilot data kept in the database and snapshots)

changes: note help and guidelines invite a few words when a choice does not convince or an option is unusual (4ee3482)
visible key-rule boxes at Result, relevance, same exposure, population, Q3, Q4; relevance title names the extraction error and the extracted data (dc79db0)
key-rule boxes for authors' significance (declared only) and sample size (no sums of groups) at the statistical-evidence and sample-size checks (5300f51, deployed 16:04:58)

analysis_notes: Sample-size 'missing' marks given before 16:04:58 (no-sums rule not yet shown) must be treated uniformly for all readers: a declared rule or a before/after split; individual corrections cover only the readers who asked.

export_participant_corrections.files: corrections.jsonl next to answers.jsonl; metadata participant_corrections and participant_corrections_sha256; schema docs/v2-export/participant_correction.schema.json
export_participant_corrections.rule: answers rows never modified; chain entries up to the cutoff exported, last applied and revalidated; primary analysis applies stated corrections, sensitivity uses the original answers; payments unchanged
